summary: RevenueCat integration verification (frontend-only, mobile viewport 390x844, public preview). SMOKE PASS: app boots, SDK runs in Browser Mode (purchases-js 1.67.1) against Test Store, zero console/page errors. PAYWALL LOAD PASS: plan step shows REAL RevenueCat packages — network-verified GET /rcbilling/v1/products returns pro.monthly=$9.99 and pro.annual=$79.99 (these are the actual Test Store prices; NOTE they differ from the $12.99/$89.99 recorded in /app/memory/revenuecat.md — dashboard prices were likely changed, memory stale). Prices rendered are from offerings, NOT fallbacks ($79.99 is not in code). TEST STORE PURCHASE FAIL (CRITICAL): purchase is permanently blocked by the identity choke-point — after Purchases.logIn(backendUid), POST /v1/subscribers/identify returns 201 and the alias is created, but customerInfo.originalAppUserId REMAINS '$RCAnonymousID:...' (documented RC behavior when an anonymous id is merged/aliased). revenuecat.tsx:70-71 & :85 treat that as identity_not_ready, so tapping 'Confirm Free Trial' only ever shows the 'Almost Ready / Preparing secure checkout' alert. This also poisons native builds because configure() always runs at module scope before logIn(). GATING PASS: fresh non-premium account force-navigated to /(tabs) is bounced to /subscription; subscribed owner visiting /subscription auto-redirects to tabs. OWNER BYPASS PASS: pytest (3/3) — GET /api/subscription returns subscribed:true for iaminamrana@gmail.com, false for a fresh account, 401 unauth; UI login as owner lands on tabs with NO purchase, Settings shows 'Hera Premium — Active'. REGRESSION PASS: sign-out removes hera_token, bounces to sign-in gate, RC identity rotates to a fresh anonymous id (logOut effective); Restore Purchases on a fresh account shows 'No Active Subscription'. Cold-reload entitlement persistence UNTESTED (blocked by purchase bug).

Checks at revenuecat.tsx:70-71 (throws identity_not_ready) and :85 (identityReady=false) therefore block every purchase with the 'Almost Ready — Preparing secure checkout' alert. integration_issues.issue: Purchase never reaches the purchases-js Test Store modal — blocked client-side by identity_not_ready choke point (see ui_bugs). Full CustomerInfo after identify: entitlements={}, original_app_user_id=$RCAnonymousID:dff235bb..., alias to backend uid created server-side.

Test Store products are priced $9.99/mo and $79.99/yr in the RC dashboard, but /app/memory/revenuecat.md and the review request state $12.99/mo and $89.99/yr. UI correctly renders the RC prices; the memory/setup expectation is stale or the dashboard config drifted. Also subscription.tsx FALLBACK_* constants ($9.99/$83.88) still render a fake-enabled CTA if offerings were empty — purchasePlan does guard with an 'Unavailable' alert, but the screen never shows an 'unavailable' empty state as required.

Declared in package.json but the paywall is custom-built (components/feature/PaywallModal); unused dependency adds bundle weight. Reference: /app/frontend/package.json:49.

action_items: CRITICAL FIX: stop using customerInfo.originalAppUserId for the identity choke-point. RC keeps original_app_user_id=$RCAnonymousID after aliasing an anonymous user (confirmed empirically + RC docs). Instead track identity readiness from a successful Purchases.logIn(uid) resolution (SubscriptionContext already has rcIdentityRef — expose it through useRCSubscription or a shared state, e.g. currentAppUserId set on logIn/logOut), and use that for purchasePlan's identityReady and the purchaseMutation guard. Also fix the misleading '[RevenueCat] identity bound' log which prints originalAppUserId.
After the fix, re-test the full Test Store purchase: Confirm Free Trial -> purchases-js Test Store modal -> entitlement 'pro' active -> land on /(tabs) -> cold-reload persistence.

Reconcile pricing: RC dashboard shows pro.monthly=$9.99 / pro.annual=$79.99 vs documented $12.99/$89.99 — update the dashboard via the integration proxy (POST .../products with amount_micros) or update /app/memory/revenuecat.md.
Minor: plan label for bypass accounts defaults to 'Annual' (SubscriptionContext.tsx:127-133) — return 'free'/'premium' gracefully when subscribed without a matching package.
Minor: show an explicit 'offerings unavailable' empty state (no fake-priced CTA) on the plan step when availablePackages is empty, per the review requirement.
Optional: add testID props to paywall/auth/sign-out interactive elements; remove unused react-native-purchases-ui.
critical_code_review_comments: revenuecat.tsx:18 rcEnabled = Platform.OS !== 'web' || __DEV__ — Browser Mode only in dev; production web builds silently disable RC (acceptable if intended, but paywall on prod web would show fallbacks forever).

revenuecat.tsx:70-71 choke-point premise is wrong for RC semantics: originalAppUserId is the FIRST-ever id, not the current one. There is no current-appUserId getter exposed by react-native-purchases 10.11.0 (checked dist/*.d.ts), so identity readiness must come from the logIn() resolution path, not CustomerInfo.
SubscriptionContext.tsx:87-92: logIn result's customerInfo.originalAppUserId is logged as proof of binding — it is not proof. The 201 identify response with alias creation is.
subscription.tsx:62-64: stripSuffix regex won't strip '$79.99/yr' variants like ' / yr'; harmless now since RC price strings contain no suffix.
Owner bypass correctly layered: GET /api/subscription checks user.is_premium OR email in PREMIUM_BYPASS_EMAILS (server.py:808-815); pytest verified true/false/401.
No deprecated expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch usage in the RevenueCat-touched files.

rca_of_issue: BUG: Test Store purchase permanently blocked ('Almost Ready — Preparing secure checkout'). Reproduction: fresh account -> /subscription -> sign in -> plan step -> Start Free Trial -> Confirm Free Trial -> alert appears every time. RCA: _layout.tsx configures RevenueCat at module scope, creating an anonymous user ($RCAnonymousID:x). On sign-in, SubscriptionContext calls Purchases.logIn(backendUid); network capture shows POST /v1/subscribers/identify {app_user_id:$RCAnonymousID:x, new_app_user_id:uid} -> 201 and the alias exists server-side (GET /v1/subscribers/<uid> returns the subscriber), but original_app_user_id remains $RCAnonymousID:x — documented RC behavior when an anonymous identity is merged into a new provided id. revenuecat.tsx:70-71 throws 'identity_not_ready' when originalAppUserId starts with '$RCAnonymousID:', and identityReady (line 85) never becomes true, so purchasePlan always shows the 'Almost Ready' alert. Mitigation: drive the choke-point from the successful Purchases.logIn(uid) resolution (track currentAppUserId/identityBound in state) instead of customerInfo.originalAppUserId; purchases-js exposes getAppUserId() if a current-id read is needed on web. Same flaw would block purchases on native builds where configure() precedes logIn().
